description: This file defines the Administration class for SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean. It manages system configuration settings, including retrieving, saving, and checking SMTP errors. It also manages related outbound email configuration.

classes.name: Administration
classes.description: Class for managing administration settings and configurations within SuiteCRM. Extends SugarBean and provides methods to retrieve and save configuration data, check SMTP errors, and handle outbound email settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Administration object and setting up custom fields.

methods.name: checkSmtpError
methods.description: Checks for SMTP configuration errors and optionally displays a warning.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves system settings from the database, optionally filtered by category and with cache support.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration settings, including outbound email settings.

methods.name: saveSetting
methods.description: Saves a single configuration setting into the database.

methods.name: get_config_prefix
methods.description: Parses a string to extract prefix components used in configuration keys.
